features.justification_quote: Hard stop at 20 turns. Most spirals manifest by turn 12; 20 captures tail. Caps worst-case spend.

features.quote: If the positive control (fixed harness) pass rate is <70%, the task is too hard. Abort that task from the battery.
features.justification_quote: The FSB measures spiral susceptibility, not baseline coding ability. A model that fails a fixed harness for legitimate reasons introduces confounding.
